rumusPerhitungan.title: Transaction Calculation Formula
rumusPerhitungan.formula: [(Selling Price – Buying Price) x Contract Size x n Lot] – [(Facility Fee + VAT) x n Lot]

details.label: Contract Size
details.value: US $5 per point for stock index rolling spot contracts and 100 troy ounces for Loco London gold daily rolling contracts.

details.label: n Lot
details.value: n is the number of lots transacted.

details.label: Facility Fee (commission)
details.value: US $15 per lot per side (buy or sell). Total commission fee is US $30 for 1 lot settlement.

details.label: VAT (Value Added Tax)
details.value: 11% of the commission fee which is US $1.65 /lot/side. Total VAT fee is US $3.3 for 1 lot settlement.

details.label: Overnight/Roll Over Fee
details.value: If the transaction settlement is done for more than one day (overnight), each transaction lot will be charged an overnight/roll over fee.

examples.title: Example 1
examples.description: A client takes a buy position on HKK5U at 24,600 points for 2 lots. Then the client closes/liquidates the buy position of 2 lots when the index is at 24,700 points.
calculation: P/L = [ ( Selling Price – Buying Price ) x Contract Size x n Lot ] – [ ( Fee US $ 30 + VAT ) x n Lot ]
P/L = ( 100 points x US $ 5 x 2 lot ) – ( US $ 33.3 x 2 )

examples.title: Example 2
examples.description: A client predicts that the Hang Seng Index will strengthen, so they open a buy position on HKK5U at 24,600 points for 1 lot. However, the index movement does not match their prediction, so the client closes/liquidates the buy position of 1 lot at a loss when the index is at 24,550 points.
calculation: P/L = [ ( Selling Price – Buying Price ) x Contract Size x n Lot ] – [ ( Fee US $ 30 + VAT ) x n Lot ]
P/L = ( – 50 points x US $ 5 x 1 lot ) – ( US $ 33.3 x 1 lot )

examples.title: Example 3
examples.description: A client predicts that the price of Loco London silver will rise, so they take a buy position on XAGF contract at $24.175/troy ounce for 1 lot. The client liquidates their position at $24.200.
calculation: P/L = [ ( Selling Price – Buying Price ) x Contract Size x n Lot ] - [ ( Facility Fee + VAT ) x n Lot ]
P/L = [ ( US $ 24,200 / troy ounce – US $ 24,175 / troy ounce ) x 100 troy ounce x 1 lot ] – [ ( US $ 30 + US $ 3.3 ) x 1 lot ]
P/L = ( 0.025 / troy ounce x 100 troy ounce x 1 lot ) – ( US $ 33.3 )
The client makes a profit of US$ 91.70
P/L = [ ( US $ 24,155 / troy ounce – US $ 24,175 / troy ounce ) x 100 troy ounce x 1 lot ] – [ ( US $ 30 + US $ 3.3 ) x 1 lot ]
P/L = (- 0.020 / troy ounce x 100 troy ounce x 1 lot ) – ( US $ 33.3 )
The client incurs a loss of - US$ 133.30

examples.title: Example 4
examples.description: An investor predicts that the Nikkei 225 Index will weaken (bearish), so on June 10 the investor opens a sell position at 14,850 points for 2 lots. Two days later (June 12), the investor closes/liquidates the sell position of 2 lots when the index is at 14,650 points.
calculation: P/L = [ ( Selling Price – Buying Price ) x Contract Size x n Lot ] - [ ( Fee US $ 30 + VAT ) x n Lot ]
P/L = ( 200 points x US $ 5 x 2 lot ) – ( US $ 33.3 x 2 lot )
Roll over fee (US $ 2 x 2 lot x 2 nights) = US $ 8

examples.title: Example 5
examples.description: An investor predicts that the Loco London gold index trend will strengthen (bullish), so today the investor opens a buy position on the daily rolling Loco London gold contract (XUL10) at US $ 1170.25 / troy ounce for 2 lots. The next day the investor closes/liquidates the buy position of 2 lots of XUL10 contract when the index is at US $ 1185.25 / troy ounce.
calculation: P/L = [ ( Selling Price – Buying Price ) x Contract Size x n Lot ] - [ ( Fee US $ 10 + VAT ) x n Lot ]
P/L = [ ( US $ 1185.25 / troy ounce – US $ 1170.25 / troy ounce ) x 100 troy ounce x 2 lot ] – [ ( US $ 30 + US $ 3.3 ) x 2 lot ]
Roll over fee (US $ 5 x 2 lot x 1 night) = US $ 10
Net profit = US $ 2923.4 or Rp 29,234,000 (fixed rate US $ 1 = Rp 10,000.00)

directRates.title: For DIRECT RATES:
directRates.formula: P/L = (Selling Price - Buying Price) x Contract Size x Number of Lots

indirectRates.title: For INDIRECT RATES:
indirectRates.formula: P/L = (Selling Price - Buying Price) / Selling Price x Contract Size x Number of Lots

penarikanDana.title: Funds Withdrawal Procedure (Withdrawal)
penarikanDana.description: PT Equityworld Futures ensures that the funds withdrawal process is transparent, efficient, and fully compliant with regulations. Clients may submit a withdrawal request at any time, as long as the requested amount does not exceed the Effective Margin recorded in their daily transaction report (Statement Report).
prosesSteps: Clients submit a withdrawal request via the Withdrawal menu in their live trading account, in accordance with the applicable terms and conditions.
The withdrawal request form must be completed accurately and in full so that the process can run smoothly without delays.
Funds can only be transferred to a bank account under the Client’s own name, as stated in the verified Account Opening documents.
The standard processing time is a maximum of three business days (T+3), but PT Equityworld Futures strives to complete each request within one business day (T+1) as part of its service commitment.

petunjukTransaksi.title: TRADING GUIDELINES
petunjukTransaksi.description: PT Equityworld Futures provides two methods for submitting trading orders: online and by telephone. Before entering the live trading environment, clients are encouraged to first use the simulation features so they can better understand the flow and functions of the online trading system.
petunjukTransaksi.description2: For online transactions, clients will receive an official User ID and Password from PT Equityworld Futures as their primary access credentials to the trading platform.
petunjukTransaksi.onlineRequirements: To be able to trade online, please ensure the following requirements are met:
requirements: Have an active and stable internet connection.

requirements.text: Access the official trading platform via:

requirements: A valid online trading User ID and Password have been issued by PT Equityworld Futures (the Password can be changed by the client for security purposes).

attention.title: Attention:
attention.content: Clients are required to read and understand the terms and conditions of the online trading system as presented on the opening page. By logging into the system and executing transactions, clients are deemed to have accepted all consequences related to such transactions.
